verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.47 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 18 Jul 2023 (90% interval −0.49 to −0.31). Of 42 untouched cells given the same test, 0 showed a divergence this large (placebo p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.47); radar is inconclusive (radar backscatter (VH) −1.0 dB, interval −1.2 to −0.3).
